name: ANSI/IEEE reactive-power meter symbol
summary: IEEE-oriented graphical reference for reactive-power meter, with public vendor evidence and drawing-reading notes.
description: The varmeter form identifies reactive-power indication from documented measurement inputs. The sign or quadrant convention is important for generator and capacitor-control applications and must be supplied by the instrument configuration.

This is a convention-specific lookup based on the publisher's IEEE-labelled preview. The geometry here is independently drawn to explain the connection or operation; it is not a certified reproduction of the standard graphic.
readingNotes: Do not infer leading/lagging convention from page orientation.
Read the selected library and the project legend together. A vendor block identifier is meaningful within its named library and is not a universal standard-symbol code.
distinction: Reactive power in var is different from reactive energy in varh.
